## Critique
- claim-1: Supported by the supplied source passages: the integral Schur basis follows from [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 213-218], while truncated Littlewood–Richardson multiplication is explicit at lines 263-269.
- claim-2: Supported by [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 481-485].
- claim-3: Established as accepted internal computation from `research-attempt-research-plan-task-261-1`, not as external source-backed evidence. It is only a bounded check and is not needed for the universal proof.
- claim-4: The argument is complete under the accepted quotient-conjugation and ideal-correspondence premises. Since \(|\lambda'|=|\lambda|\), \(\Omega\) is graded and sends \(A_+\) to \(A^\vee_+\). It therefore sends \(A_+J_v\) degreewise onto \(A^\vee_+J_{v^\vee}\) and descends to an integral graded quotient isomorphism. Each degreewise isomorphism preserves the torsion subgroup, invariant factors, and free \(\mathbb Z\)-rank.

The requested standalone target is established, with the right-hand \(A_+\) understood as \(A^\vee_+\). No broader parent theorem is inferred.
